additional_info.subject: Incident Report – Issue on Connector 3 (Right) of Charger MP/R6 170002001
additional_info.body:
Hello,
On charger MP/R6 – S/N 170002001, connector 3 (right) initiates the charging session, but the instantaneous power remains at 0 kW. The charger behaves as if the session is running, but no energy is delivered.
Tests performed:
Volvo FM Electric truck:
Attempt on connector 3 → same result (0 kW delivered).
Attempt on connector 1 at 10:03:36 → charging successful.
Audi passenger vehicle:
Attempt on connector 3 (right) → same problem observed (0 kW delivered).
Charging is not possible on connector 3 (right). The issue is reproducible with different vehicles.
Please investigate the root cause of this issue and provide corrective actions to restore full functionality.
Best regards,
Malek DRIF | Head of Operations | Mob: +33 650 370 485
